{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
# Since both are missing in the same two rows, we can drop them
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Confirm the number of rows after dropping
print(f"Number of rows after dropping missing values: {len(df_clean)}")

# Compute Pearson correlation between flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g
pearson_corr = df_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(df_clean['body_mass_g'])

print(f"Pearson correlation coefficient: {pearson_corr}")

# Return the value
pearson_corr"}
